title: Finite Tate coefficients descend from pro-etale to etale sites
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $F/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with valuation ring $\mathcal O_F$, uniformizer $\varpi_F$, and $n\geq1$, and set $A=\mathcal O_F/\varpi_F^n$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Let $T$ be a scheme on which $\ell$ is invertible [def-pc-scheme], and let $\nu_T:T_{\mathrm{proet}}\to T_{\mathrm{et}}$ be the site comparison [def-weil-pbc-site-comparison-morphism]. For every $r\geq1$ such that $\ell^rA=0$, set
$$A_T^{\mathrm{et}}(1)=\mu_{\ell^r,T}^{\mathrm{et}}\otimes_{\mathbf Z/\ell^r}A_T$$
using the finite etale Tate sheaf of [lem-asd-etale-finite-twist-pullback]. For the finite-level pro-etale Tate sheaf $A_T^{\mathrm{pro}}(1)$ of [def-coefficient-twists-detailed], there is a canonical isomorphism
$$\nu_T^*A_T^{\mathrm{et}}(1)\xrightarrow{\sim}A_T^{\mathrm{pro}}(1).$$
It identifies the tensor powers $\nu_T^*A_T^{\mathrm{et}}(a)$ with $A_T^{\mathrm{pro}}(a)$ for all $a\geq0$, where powers and derived tensor have the conventions of [def-kun-derived-tensor]. These isomorphisms commute with scheme pullback and with the transition $z\mapsto z^{\ell^{r'-r}}$ when $r'\geq r$; in particular the etale sheaf and its comparison are canonically independent of the annihilating power. The etale descent with this comparison is unique up to the unique comparison-preserving isomorphism. No divisibility assumption on $n$ by the ramification index is required.

proof.text: Obtain the family b of normalized comparisons in every nonnegative degree from lem-amb-finite-tate-normalized-comparisons. Apply lem-amb-finite-tate-normalized-coherence to get normalized scheme pullback squares and exponent transitions.

Comparison inverse image is fully faithful for ModuleCat(A). Its fully faithful isomorphism equivalence lifts b followed by alpha inverse to a unique isomorphism of etale descents. The same equivalence with alpha=b_r proves uniqueness of every exponent transition from its comparison square. The Lean proof performs both cancellations explicitly.

lean.statement:
theorem finite_tate_site_descent :
    ∃ b : ∀ (T : Scheme.{u}), IsUnit (l : Γ(T, ⊤)) →
      ∀ (r : ℕ) (hA : ((l ^ (r + 1) : ℕ) : finiteTateCoefficient l E n) = 0) (k : ℕ),
      (ProEtale.comparisonUpperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (finiteTateCoefficient l E n)) T).obj
        (finiteEtaleTateTwist T (l ^ (r + 1)) _ hA k) ≅ finiteTateProSheaf l E n T k,
    (∀ (T : Scheme.{u}) (hT : IsUnit (l : Γ(T, ⊤))) (r : ℕ)
      (hA : ((l ^ (r + 1) : ℕ) : finiteTateCoefficient l E n) = 0) (k : ℕ),
      IsFiniteTateSiteComparison l E n T r hA k (b T hT r hA k)) ∧
    (∀ (T T' : Scheme.{u}) (v : T' ⟶ T)
      (hT : IsUnit (l : Γ(T, ⊤))) (hT' : IsUnit (l : Γ(T', ⊤)))
      (r : ℕ) (hA : ((l ^ (r + 1) : ℕ) : finiteTateCoefficient l E n) = 0) (k : ℕ),
      ∃ (c : (Etale.upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (finiteTateCoefficient l E n)) v).obj
          (finiteEtaleTateTwist T (l ^ (r + 1)) _ hA k) ≅
            finiteEtaleTateTwist T' (l ^ (r + 1)) _ hA k)
        (d : (ProEtale.upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (finiteTateCoefficient l E n)) v).obj
          (finiteTateProSheaf l E n T k) ≅ finiteTateProSheaf l E n T' k),
      IsFiniteTateEtalePullback l E n T v r hA k c ∧
      IsFiniteTateProPullback l E n T v k d ∧
      (ProEtale.upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (finiteTateCoefficient l E n)) v).mapIso
          (b T hT r hA k) ≪≫ d =
        (ProEtale.comparisonUpperStarCompUpperStarIso
          (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (finiteTateCoefficient l E n)) v).app
            (finiteEtaleTateTwist T (l ^ (r + 1)) _ hA k) ≪≫
        (ProEtale.comparisonUpperStar
          (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (finiteTateCoefficient l E n)) T').mapIso c ≪≫ b T' hT' r hA k) ∧
    (∀ (T : Scheme.{u}) (hT : IsUnit (l : Γ(T, ⊤))) (r r' : ℕ) (_h : r ≤ r')
      (hA : ((l ^ (r + 1) : ℕ) : finiteTateCoefficient l E n) = 0)
      (hA' : ((l ^ (r' + 1) : ℕ) : finiteTateCoefficient l E n) = 0) (k : ℕ),
      ∃! t : finiteEtaleTateTwist T (l ^ (r' + 1)) _ hA' k ≅
          finiteEtaleTateTwist T (l ^ (r + 1)) _ hA k,
        IsFiniteTateEtaleTransition l E n T r r' hA hA' k t ∧
        (ProEtale.comparisonUpperStar
          (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (finiteTateCoefficient l E n)) T).mapIso t ≪≫ b T hT r hA k =
            b T hT r' hA' k) ∧
    (∀ (T : Scheme.{u}) (hT : IsUnit (l : Γ(T, ⊤))) (r : ℕ)
      (hA : ((l ^ (r + 1) : ℕ) : finiteTateCoefficient l E n) = 0) (k : ℕ)
      (G : Sheaf T.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (finiteTateCoefficient l E n)))
      (alpha : (ProEtale.comparisonUpperStar
        (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (finiteTateCoefficient l E n)) T).obj G ≅
          finiteTateProSheaf l E n T k),
      ∃! h : finiteEtaleTateTwist T (l ^ (r + 1)) _ hA k ≅ G,
        (ProEtale.comparisonUpperStar
          (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (finiteTateCoefficient l E n)) T).mapIso h ≪≫ alpha =
            b T hT r hA k)
